title: Post-Quantum Custody Platform Strongpoint Adds Quantus As Development Partner
summary: Project Eleven and Quantus plan to integrate the Quantus Network with Strongpoint, Project Eleven's institutional custody platform for post-quantum blockchain assets. Quantus has joined as a development partner, with support targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

title: OSL Brings A USDGO Market-Neutral Fund On-Chain For Hong Kong Investors
summary: OSL Group has tokenized the USDGO Plus SP fund on-chain and is providing custody and distribution through its licensed Hong Kong platform. The product is a market-neutral digital asset fund built around USDGO and is available only to eligible professional investors.

title: PowerCompute Mines 8.1 Bitcoin In September After Using BTC To Slash Debt
summary: PowerCompute mined 8.1 BTC in September, up 37% from a year earlier. Its month-end Bitcoin holdings fell to 63.7 BTC after the company used 267.4 BTC to help retire a $22.45 million Bitcoin-backed credit facility, leaving most of its secured debt eliminated.

title: Strategy Sets October 29 Date For Its Next Major Bitcoin Treasury Update
summary: Strategy will report third-quarter 2026 results after US markets close on October 29 and hold a live webinar at 5 p.m. Eastern Time. The update will give investors the next full financial snapshot of the world's largest corporate Bitcoin treasury.

title: BNY Expands Regulated Crypto Custody Across The European Union Under MiCA
summary: BNY has expanded its Digital Asset Custody platform to selected institutional clients across the European Union under MiCA. The move follows the addition of its European banking entity to the ESMA MiCA register and gives one of the world's largest custody banks a regulated route to hold and administer crypto assets in the region.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $484.9 Million As BlackRock Leads A Broad Day Of Outflows
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $484.9 million in net outflows on October 7, according to Farside Investors. BlackRock's IBIT led the withdrawals with $207.7 million leaving the fund, while Fidelity and ARK also posted nine-figure outflows.

title: Polygon Opens Its Money Stack To TRON’s $94 Billion USDT Market
summary: Polygon Open Money Stack now supports TRON, giving payment and fintech businesses a single infrastructure layer for bank transfers, wallets, cross-chain routing and payouts involving TRC-20 USDT. Polygon says more than $94 billion of USDT currently circulates on TRON.

title: Sui’s Hashi Bitcoin Finance Network Launches With More Than $500 Million Committed
summary: Hashi, Sui's native Bitcoin finance infrastructure, will begin a phased mainnet rollout later this month with more than $500 million in committed capital. Anchorage Digital has joined the launch coalition, giving institutional clients routes into Hashi through qualified custody and self-custody infrastructure.

title: Chainlink Launches One-Click Cross-Chain Vault Deposits Across 80+ Blockchains
summary: Chainlink has launched CCIP Vault Adapters, allowing DeFi vaults on one network to accept deposits from users across more than 80 supported blockchains without asking those users to bridge assets manually. Aave, Lombard, Venus, Veda and several other platforms are already adopting the infrastructure.

title: Coinbase And Samsung Bring USDC Directly Into Samsung Wallet
summary: Coinbase is powering USDC inside Samsung Wallet, with the stablecoin feature due to reach 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the United States from the final week of October. Coinbase Prime will custody the USDC, while Samsung says eligible users will be able to send funds to crypto wallets and qualifying bank accounts in more than 60 countries.
